whatTheSignatureProves: The recorded message ids, server times, corroboration signals, clause and verdict have not changed since sealing. This pack holds no photo hash: its photo was not stored (pageSha256s is [null], bol_media_hashed is false, confidence low), because the driver messages were synthetic. A pack from a real phone carries the photo's sha256. No signature proves where a phone physically was or what a photo shows.
